svg.title: Map the Process as It Really Runs
svg.desc: A real appointment-reminder process mapped step by step shows the same client details typed into three systems; after mapping, one entry feeds the reminders and texts, while research and planning are checked by opening sources and testing the plan with the team.
svg.text: Map the Process as It Really Runs
The bottleneck is usually a step nobody wrote down.
Open the sources key facts rest on
Steps, owners, risks; the team tests it
